title: Dear My Secretary
desc: Thee Chonlathorn, a confident and accomplished CEO, is thrown off balance when his loyal secretary of nine years, Preem Primala, unexpectedly resigns. As he seeks answers, their journey uncovers hidden emotions and truths that could change their lives forever.
